svg.data-cluster-capacity: 4 Tbps standalone, scaling to 192 Tbps in a DDC cluster
svg.data-tcam: Broadcom OP2 BCM16K external TCAM, up to 16 parallel searches
svg.data-deployment: standalone core or edge router, or a packet-forwarding building block of a distributed disaggregated chassis (DDC) when its fabric ports are cabled to a UfiSpace S9705-48D or S9725-64E fabric switch. (Keyed `deployment` rather than `role`: `role` is reserved for the structural one each GROUP carries, and two different meanings under one key is what that rule exists to stop)
svg.data-fabric-ports: the 13 QSFP-DD ports of the fabric block are 400GE only and connect ONLY to the fabric ports of an S9705-48D or S9725-64E - the HIG's Port Overview says so explicitly - so they carry no customer traffic and take no optics from the service list
svg.data-zr-ports: 400ZR and OpenZR+ run on six of the ten service ports - 0, 1, 4, 5, 8 and 9, the left column of each ganged shell (datasheet prose, and HIG Figure 8's highlight read against the printed numbering)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: SERVICE ports, up to 600 km: 400GE QSFP-DD OpenZR+, ZR, SR8, ER4, LR4, DR4 and 100GE QSFP28 ZR4, ER4, LR4, SR4, with 400ZR and OpenZR+ on ports 0, 1, 4, 5, 8 and 9 only. FABRIC ports, up to 100 m: 400GE QSFP-DD DAC, AEC and AOC cable only - no optical transceiver is listed for them and they connect only to an S9705-48D or S9725-64E. One key covers both blocks because both are qsfp-dd media; which list applies is decided by the group, not by the cage
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the two SFP+ management ports are 10G; the datasheet's Compatible Transceiver Types block names QSFP-DD and QSFP28 parts only and lists no SFP+ optic, so what is qualified in these two cages is not stated by the vendor
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console, both labelled IOIO
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A; AS/NZS CISPR 32, Class A; Anatel; NEBS GR-1089
svg.data-nebs: NEBS Level 3 (datasheet Key Benefits, 'Ideal for Core, Edge, and Central Office deployments (NEBS Level 3)')
